run_decimate_mesh: run the decimate script to reduce triangle count of 3D mesh files from input to output
run_decimate_verbose: run the decimate script with verbose output to see detailed processing information for each mesh
run_decimate_quiet: run the decimate script in quiet mode to suppress all processing output messages
review_decimate_function: review the decimate function that simplifies 3D meshes using meshoptimizer with configurable target triangle counts
review_meshoptimizer_configuration: review the meshoptimizer configuration settings including simplifyTargetError and simplifyTargetIndexCountThreshold for mesh simplification
